outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
Infant feeding method at 3 months postpartum
cohort: 1221 nulliparous women who gave birth vaginally or by emergency caesarean section
finding: EA use was associated with an increased risk of assisted birth, longer labor duration, higher likelihood of medical interventions (IV syntocinon, antibiotics), pyrexia, and lower breastfeeding rates at three months postpartum.
mod_finding: EA use was associated with an increased risk of vacuum-assisted birth and forceps-assisted birth.
